'''Amadaine 6 (June 13)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - [[Egwene]] and [[Nynaeve]] are taught by [[Liandrin]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Perrin]] arrives in [[Emond's Field]] and learns his family is dead and the [[Cauthon]]s and [[Luhhan]]s were made prisoners by [[Whitecloaks]]. He meets with [[Tam al'Thor]], [[Abell Cauthon]], [[Verin Mathwin]], and [[Alanna Mosvani]].
